name: smwmusic-umamusume-pretty-derby-girls-legend-u-star-mix
title: Umamusume: Pretty Derby - Girls' Legend U (Star-mix)
description:
Did a short arrangement of Girls' Legend U from Umamusume: Pretty Derby. Found out this song could be shortened to be used PERFECTLY with SMW's global music. Also, this makes 3 Umamusume-related submissions on here (y'all should do more with me).

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Bass is @14 (Slap Bass)
ㅤㅤ ♠ Will not work w/ global tracks unless you go into "Addmusic_sample groups.txt" and add a "!" in front of "DEFAULT/0D SMW @14.brr"
ㅤ2. Bass is @8 (Fingered Bass)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤㅤ ♠ Will work w/ global tracks

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Enables the Intro (INTRO Enabled)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. Cuts the Intro (INTRO Cut)
